title: gf(x) = 1/(3x − 2) meets 1/5 at x = 7/3
caption: gf has a break at x = 2/3, where 3x − 2 = 0, so that value is excluded from the domain. The curve meets y = 1/5 at x = 7/3.
alt: The two branches of y = 1/(3x − 2) either side of x = 2/3, and the horizontal line y = 0.2 meeting the right branch at x = 7/3.
description: At x = 2/3 the denominator is zero: the graph has a break and the domain excludes it.
1/(3x − 2) = 1/5 gives 3x − 2 = 5, so x = 7/3, where the right branch meets y = 1/5.
